intro: Ink portraits of characters who stuck with me. One film, one face, one quote.

drawings.quote: I’ve seen horrors. Horrors that you have seen. But you have no right to call me a murderer, you have a right to kill me.
drawings.alt: Ink drawing of Colonel Kurtz from Apocalypse Now, white on black: a shaved head with the eyes lost in shadow, and dog tags on a chain at his collar.
Ink drawing of Travis Bickle from Taxi Driver in profile, with a mohawk and an army jacket, in solid black on white.

drawings.quote: You’re embarrassing yourself here, lads. Kids stab, girls shoot, boys punch. Grown-ups fight with their heads. That’s where the real battle is up here, in the grey. Now, wake up, lads. Life’s quick. You’re slow. Life’s hard on a bone top.
drawings.alt: Ink drawing of Coach from The Gentlemen in a flat cap and glasses, one hand raised to his face, wearing a plaid track jacket.
